# Climate Impacts Tracker Asia

> A comprehensive platform tracking climate change effects, impacts, and disasters across Asia with focus on regional vulnerabilities, economic consequences, and social justice dimensions.

Climate Impacts Tracker Asia (CITA) monitors global climate impacts with particular emphasis on Asian regions, providing curated articles on extreme weather, environmental crises, health effects, and climate financing gaps. The platform combines scientific research from organizations like IPCC, WMO, and NASA with regional analysis to inform policy and public understanding.

## Key Topics

- Climate Change Impacts
- Asia Climate Risk
- Extreme Weather Events
- Sea Level Rise
- Economic Impacts
- Health Effects
- Environmental Justice
- Climate Disasters
- Gender Inequality
- Climate Financing Gap
- Social Impacts
- Climate Adaptation
- Temperature Records
- Regional Vulnerability
- Climate Justice

## Regional Climate Impacts

- [Air Pollution in India: Devastating Health Effects](https://www.climateimpactstracker.com/air-pollution-in-india-devastating-health-effects): India air pollution health crisis in Delhi and nationwide

- [Extreme Heatwaves Take a Toll on Public Health and the Economy in Bangladesh](https://www.climateimpactstracker.com/extreme-heatwaves-take-a-toll-on-public-health-and-the-economy-in-bangladesh): Bangladesh heatwaves health crisis and economic inequality
- [Asian At Risk Amid Warnings of Increasing Flood Risk](https://www.climateimpactstracker.com/asian-at-risk-amid-warnings-of-increasing-flood-risk): Asia flood risk analysis amid climate-driven rainfall increases
- [Are the Maldives Sinking?](https://www.climateimpactstracker.com/are-the-maldives-sinking): Maldives sea level rise and island nation climate vulnerability
- [Asia Faces the Biggest Climate Risk and the Largest Climate Financing Gap](https://www.climateimpactstracker.com/asia-biggest-climate-risk-largest-climate-financing-gap): Asia climate risk and financing gap analysis by region
